calls.name: read_file
calls.expectToolResult: does not count a line just past the change

explanation.what: The base branch of overlapsChange, which compares a location against the lines a hunk deleted, has no test.
explanation.why: This change added the branch and the revision field, and left test/overlap.test.ts covering only head locations.
explanation.fix: Add a test for a base location: { line: 12, revision: "base" } overlaps the edit hunk, and { line: 13, revision: "base" } does not.

arguments.failureScenario: Every test in test/overlap.test.ts passes a location without revision, so none reaches the base branch. If it read hunk.newStart and hunk.newLines instead of the old ones, a base location on deleted line 12 of the edit hunk would no longer count, and a finding the deletion caused would read as unrelated, yet all three tests would still pass.
